reviews.text:
Dr. Cohen saved Mengmeng's life. I'm not exaggerating..

maybe TMI, but laying it out there: UTIs are a pain we can all empathize with. For male cats, it can turn into a urinary blockage. and that is DEADLY.

We first took Mengmeng to Bond Vet; they spent about 15 minutes with him, checked for a blockage, found none, and sent him home. discomfort followed..

Then Dr. Cohen found a fully obstructed urinary tract and a bladder that badly needed relief. He sedated Mengmeng, placed a catheter, and started IV fluids. Then he kept him for 3 days in-patient at the clinic.

spicy part: Mengmeng is an 8-year-old outdoor soul. Cinic is not his scene. On day two he growled, bit, scratched.. and ripped out his own catheter. Dr. Cohen was double-booked that morning. He still emailed us every option in plain words: re-catheterize, refer out for surgery, or try treating him at home. By the afternoon, the catheter was back in and the urine was clear; no surgery needed–thank god.

Dr. Cohen was incredible communicative, informative, and patient with all our questions. He patiently answered every question from me and my mom (there were many). He named the drugs and procedures. When Mengmeng came home drowsy and glassy-eyed, we already knew why: Zorbium, a skin-applied sedative that lasts a few days. Being informed turned panic into patience.

He also trimmed Mengmeng's nails too. Nobody asked; we noticed. [photo 1: Mengmeng home, recovering]

On price: Moderate and thoughtfully priced. We paid practically the same at Bond Vet for a 15-minute visit as we did here for a 3-day stay, a diagnosis, and a cat who came home alive.

For other cat parents: If your male cat is straining, peeing very little, or crying in the litter box.. don't wait. And if the first answer is "nothing's wrong" but he still isn't right, get a second opinion.

Mengmeng is home now, on meds and appropriate urinary food, and back to judging us. [photos 2+3: Mengmeng, back to himself]

Thanks Doctor Cohen at Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic. We are grateful. 🙏

The staff were incredibly accommodating and friendly. Dr. Dubinsky was very thorough when examining Zoey and Ziggy. I knew something was off with my baby — at first I thought it was just allergies, but the doctor found she also has ear and a skin infection because she checked every inch of Zoey’s body.

My dog was bitten by another dog, and I was extremely worried about him developing an infection, especially because of his old age… He’s also not the easiest dog to handle, which made me even more anxious about the whole situation. Unfortunately, I wasn’t able to take him myself because of work so my parents took him instead. Since they aren’t fluent in English, I was worried about whether everything would be communicated properly. I expressed all of my concerns to the vet, and they immediately put me at ease. They were incredibly kind, transparent, and super duperrrr understanding.They even offered to call me during the whole visit so I can listen on the phone! Wow so thoughtful… They took the time to explain everything clearly to my parents and to me on the phone.
I truly appreciate finding a vet I can actually trust. Thank you for treating my dog with such genuine care and for giving me peace of mind. Huge shout out to the person that spoke to me on the phone & Dr. Dublinsky!!♥️♥️♥️

I called 6 different vets in Bayside/Flushing before choosing here. Let me just say.. I made the right choice.

11 Years as a Client — A Very Disappointing Final Experience

I have been bringing my cat, Bubba, to Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic for her entire life—11 years—and Dr. Cohen has been her veterinarian for most of that time. I want to start by saying that I appreciate the care Dr. Cohen has provided over the years and I do believe he is a knowledgeable veterinarian. Unfortunately, my most recent experience has made me decide that I will no longer be returning to the practice.

Bubba is not an aggressive cat, but she can become frightened and vocal when she is uncomfortable, particularly during blood draws or urine collection. When I am allowed to stay with her, I talk to her and pet her, and she generally calms down. During her recent visit, she was hissing because her bladder was not full and the urine collection was uncomfortable. Dr. Cohen suggested bringing her back the following morning with a full bladder and also mentioned gabapentin to help calm her. I explained that she has never needed it before and asked if we could first try the procedure with a full bladder without medication. He said I could do what I felt was comfortable.

The morning i went, Dr. Cohen was not there. When the assistant came to take Bubba, I specifically told her that I wanted to accompany Bubba because being present during her examinations and procedures is very important to me. As I stood up to go with them, the assistant simply took Bubba and walked away, despite me clearly expressing that I wanted to be there. I did not feel that my concern as her owner was heard or respected.

Afterward, I asked to speak with the doctor because I was upset about how the situation had been handled. The doctor I spoke with was understanding and explained the reasoning behind using gabapentin, which I appreciated. I want to be clear that I am not opposed to medication when it is genuinely necessary. My concern is the feeling that there is sometimes an expectation to medicate or sedate a frightened animal rather than first allowing time, patience, and the presence of their owner to help them through the procedure.

Unfortunately, there was another issue that concerned me even more. When Bubba came back out, I noticed she seemed unusual. On the drive home she was bracing herself inside her carrier. When we arrived, I discovered that the entire carrier was filled with urine and Bubba’s fur was soaked in it. I was not informed that this had happened. When I called the clinic, I was told that she may have been frightened and urinated in the carrier. In 11 years, this has never happened to her.

The combination of my concerns being dismissed, not being allowed to accompany my cat despite clearly asking to do so, and then discovering her soaked in urine without anyone informing me has unfortunately changed my confidence in the practice.

I am grateful to Dr. Cohen for the care he has provided Bubba throughout her life. I sincerely hope the practice takes this feedback as an opportunity to reconsider how frightened or vocal animals are handled and, equally importantly, how owners’ concerns and requests are communicated and respected.

This review is not about expecting special treatment. It is about wanting patience, communication, and compassion when an animal is scared and respect for the person who has trusted the practice with that animal for 11 years.

I am a single mom and am financially drained from taking my poor cat Luna to the ER vet and still having no answers. As per my coworker's recommendation, I took my poor girl when she was having a really bad medical emergency. I burst into tears at the end of the appointment because I was treated with compassion and in one visit, they gave my girl a thorough exam, drew blood, gave her IV, anti-nausea and were very honest about what she was facing. The staff and doctor were phenomenal, and the price was incredibly fair. I am hoping I can start helping my cat get better with their help and am so grateful to have been recommended this clinic.

I had an emergency with my cat who passed away unexpectedly. I reached out to Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic and they were able to accommodate my wishes to have her cremated. It was a sad experience but the staff at the clinic handled my request professionally. My cat Izzy was treated with dignity as a valued member of my family.
Thank you to the team at Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic
The staff at Fresh Meadows Animal clinic are super wonderful.  I love the caring and gentle way Dr. Cohen handles and treat my cat Lulu. I'm grateful for them all. 🙏 💖💖💖🐈 …

Overall, our experience at this pet clinic was positive. The reception staff was friendly, the service was efficient, and the veterinarian was knowledgeable and caring. We felt that our pet was treated well during the visit.

However, there was one issue that left us concerned. We were given a complimentary sample of deworming medication, only to discover that it had expired nearly three years ago. When we called the clinic to ask about it, we were told that it was still okay to use.

While I understand that some medications may retain effectiveness beyond their expiration date, I found it surprising that a veterinary clinic would distribute medication that had been expired for such a long period of time. This isn’t simply a product that is slightly past a “best by” date—it’s medication intended for pets’ health and safety.

The situation made me uncomfortable and raised questions about the clinic’s quality control procedures. I appreciate the care we received from the doctor and staff, but I believe expired medications, especially those expired by several years, should not be given to clients. I hope the clinic reviews this practice moving forward.
The Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic team are kind and empathetic. Dr. Cohen is a very caring doctor. I highly recommend this place for your fur baby's needs.

There are closer vets. I drive across Queens anyway.

A friend put me onto this place and I’ve never looked back. I appreciate Dr. Cohen’s directness and no-fluff approach. When Milo’s in his hands, I’m assured he’s genuinely examining him and not just looking for a way to cash me out.

What sells me is watching him actually work. You can see the wheels turning during an exam.  He’s reading the animal, not running a script. That kind of diagnostic instinct is rare, and it’s the whole reason I trust him with my dog.

I’ll admit he’s doesn’t seem the type to hold your hand, so if you want coddling, bring a loved one along & let the best veterinary in NYC take care of your little homie/kid/best friend.

Dr Cohen and his staff are incredibly caring and loving to animals. They treat my Dante like the prince that he is. You can really see and feel the passion the staff has for these animals. We are very lucky to have found this place!

dr cohen is really great my dog is going to him for over 10 years he saved his life twice when i was ready to put him asleep . i can only say dr Cohen is an angel to our pets
thank you very much for your services

Bad service. I’ve tried calling and they don’t accept voicemail. After the 2nd call, the machine said “they don’t accept unidentified calls”. like isn’t this a business? I just want to ask a question before booking an appointment

I brought my 18-YEAR-OLD, NEUTERED MALE cat with congestive heart failure to Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic for a scheduled echocardiogram.

Instead, he was given pre-anesthetic medications and anesthesia for a SPAY procedure. Dr. Cohen later stated there had been a mix-up with another patient.

When my mother picked him up, she was told by Dr. Cohen not to inform me of the incident (I have been in the field for ~15 years) and was discouraged from seeking care elsewhere. No post-procedure blood work or objective assessment was performed to ensure he was stable for discharge.

We took him to a 24-hour emergency hospital, where he was found to be dehydrated, hypokalemic, and in acute kidney failure. He has since required multiple ER visits for vomiting, lethargy, and not eating, along with ongoing monitoring that has cost thousands of dollars.

Dr. Cohen also stated he would not be taking action regarding the employee involved, citing that she had been “showing improvement,” and added that she is pregnant. Regardless, verifying the correct patient prior to anesthesia is a fundamental responsibility of the veterinarian.

If others have had similar experiences and are considering reporting concerns to the state veterinary licensing board, I encourage you to document everything and follow the appropriate formal complaint process. No pet or family should have to go through this.

I don't know who they have as a receptionist or speak to new patients but she was very rude. She was so cold, I canceled my appointment. She gave any a negative aura. I can't trust them with my baby. If I could've they wouldn't get any stars‼️
Been coming for years now and I still share the same sentiments of how great both the staff and service are. Would highly recommend to bring your family pet here.

My Yorkie’s teeth were in really bad shape and he needed a long overdue dental cleaning and extractions since some of his teeth were loose. As a pet parent, I was really nervous about him going through the procedure, but Dr. Cohen and the staff at Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic were incredibly kind, patient, and reassuring.

They took amazing care of my dog and made sure he was as comfortable as possible before, during, and after his procedure. The staff also kept me updated throughout the process and took the time to answer my questions, which meant so much and really put my mind at ease.

Timmy is feeling so much better after his dental work, and I’m truly grateful for the care, compassion, and attention they gave him. I highly recommend Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic to anyone looking for a vet who genuinely cares about their patients.
Great service! Didn’t have to wait long to be seen and everyone was so nice.

Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic is truly the best place to take your pets to. I’ve been taking my dog Buju there for years. They provide top quality care and treat your furry friends as their own family. The staff members are so great and provide excellent service, ensuring to create a clean and safe environment for your visits. Dr. Cohen is the best there is. He goes through everything so thoroughly so I can better understand how to care for my dog. You can always trust that Dr. Cohen and the rest of the Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic staff to be there for you and your animals. If you want top quality care for your animals, this is the only animal clinic you’ll need.

Dr. Cohen and his staff have been seeing my pup Cali since 2024. As a first responder it's refreshing to find a clinician who takes the time to answer every question and level with you on 1 to 1 basis in regards to your animals health. FMAC provides excellent preventive and urgent care and I highly recommend them for all your pet's medical necessities.

The entire Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic; are 5+++ stars. I have been bringing my fur babies here for close to two decades now. They are fantastic and they treat you with dignity as if they were family. Priceless. Thank you 🙏🏼 …

I can’t say enough good things about Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic. They took excellent care of my cat, Thor, when he was dealing with a painful ear infection. The staff was kind, patient, and clearly knowledgeable, and they made sure Thor was comfortable throughout the visit. The veterinarian explained everything clearly and took the time to answer my questions, which really put me at ease. Thor is already feeling so much better thanks to their care. I’m very grateful and would highly recommend Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic to anyone looking for compassionate and professional veterinary care.

Wonderful Doctors and team here. They will often squeeze in an appointment within 30 minutes, respond & communicate so quickly, yet most importantly - treat our babies with gentle care and ask very thorough questions.  Everything they do is thoughtful.  My cats are 11 years old, have lived overseas with me.  This is the best vet team I have ever experienced internationally.. I highly recommend the care here.  Thank you!

“Doctor” Cohen, if you can call him that, needs a lesson on empathy and compassion. He shows no care if your pet is suffering and was extremely rude and impatient while diagnosing our pup. And forget asking him to repeat details or explain anything, as he expects you to be a trained vet yourself and understand complex diagnoses. This was not a one off either. Maybe he is knowledgeable, but is better off not having to interact with people. Cannot stress how bad our experiences have been.
Excellent service. Friendly people. My kitties was thoroughly satisfied.
I highly recommend Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic. Dr. Cohen and his staff are wonderful and always take amazing care of my 3 cats and the various cats I foster!

Dr. Cohen is a superb clinician,an excellent communicator and cares deeply for his patients and their family. That my beloved cat is able to be treated at his practice is truly a blessing. His support staff is highly skilled. Special shoutout to groomer Noelle -- she is able to gently remove multiple matting on my cat with a very high level of skill. I also think the pricing is fair and reasonable. The five stars is well deserved.

What an awful experience with Cohen, if I could put zero stars I would definitely put none with out hesitation. Now let me tell you the horrendous experience I've had with my friend's dog Teddy. Teddy is a very old dog who's been abandoned and severely neglected with such horrid teeth, a messed up nail and maybe something wrong with his ear. Dr Cohen has no experience with being gentle with animals because he examined Teddy's mouth with two big wooden popsicle sticks to open up his mouth when I clearly thought only Dr's use it for humans for pressing down on the tongue and checking for strep or the throat in general. Poor Teddy wouldn't stop crying because of him being in pain and him being aggressive with Teddy and I asked Cohen why he's crying and he simply replied with "he's just acting up" first of all I never knew that a dog cries for no reason when in pain, I was almost in tears when he was crying and he showed no sympathy. When I pick up Teddy's gums and check his teeth he doesn't cry in pain, also the vet assistant she was also really aggressive with him, she would rub his head back and pet him really aggressively and pulled his eyes back. I don't understand how this vet got his degree or license and calls himself a vet, he should be ashamed for stressing out my friend's dog. When I confronted the whole place the vet ran away to the back because he couldn't handle the truth about what really goes on behind closed doors, also the vet assistant said I should get an education, first of all get an education for what? About animals or getting them examined? I'm paying the vet to check whats wrong with Teddy. This place has to be shut down for the lack of having empathy for our fur babies, please do not bring your fur babies there. Also he did not use any gloves, thats extremely unsanitary.

Hello, to all the people with dogs and cats, please be aware of going to this veterinarian. I took my dog, and he is a rescue dog, When we went to see the doctor, he put 2 big popsicle in my poor dog's mouth, and my rescue dog was screaming, and the doctor proceeded to say, that my dog was acting up. This doctor doesn't have a heart, and I believe 100%, that this doctor must get his doctor's license should be revoked. He can't be trusted because he's being, mean to the animal's. How could they have a doctor abusing the dog's, we need to have a non-abusive doctor in the community. They need this doctor to be removed and to be locked up.

Whoever gives this place 5 star reviews must be getting paid cuz this place is absolutely horrific. My friend brought her poodle here to get a checkup and the vet was so aggressive with him. He's an old little poodle how could u have the heart to treat him like an object?? A few years ago I brought my dying cat in and he held him aggressively by the scruff. This place needs to be shut down. I'm most definitely going to warn friends and family about this place
Rude customer service, I called about a neuter service immediately got put on hold then hung up on. When calling back no answer… absolutely unprofessional.
Excellent and caring office.  Highly recommend Dr. Cohen for your pets.  Very thorough.
Thanks Mario, nice meeting you and your son the other day! Dr Cohen FMAC

I took my two fur babies here (cats) and the doctor was very gentle with them and did a thorough examination.Once I can convince my third fur baby to take the calming medicine, I will take her there as well. Also, the staff I interacted with during the visit was very friendly. If you're looking for a vet, take them here

Bad service. Very rude receptionist, I called to book an appointment but was hung up on twice. It's like they are just not interested in your business, and begged you to take your fur baby somewhere else in order not to bother them already. With attitude like that, I don't trust them at all. Do not recommend.

They say the doctor will call you then he never calls. Leaves an email at 1030 at night and says to come in the next day and then he’s not even in the next day! The vet who was in that day couldn’t even see my cat. Told me to wait 2 more days until Monday. I used to like this clinic but they didn’t take my cats bladder and urine issues seriously so I’ve moved on to a different clinic.

I’m truly grateful to the universe for leading me to Dr. Cohen. A few weeks ago, my dog began vomiting and experiencing diarrhea after eating something she shouldn’t have. Soon after, she lost her appetite and couldn’t eat for several days.

As we noticed her strength and overall well-being declining, we booked an emergency appointment at a different clinic in Queens. Unfortunately, our experience there was frustrating. We paid a substantial vet bill, but they kept brushing us off when we called for guidance, as our dog still wasn't eating, which only heightened our anxiety. Even after explaining that she hadn't eaten in 7 days, we were told that the doctor wasn’t available and wouldn’t return until after the weekend.

After reaching out to a friend for advice, she recommended Dr. Cohen. My pup needed an ultrasound because she was still feeling unwell. The staff at FMAC was able to schedule us quickly for both the ultrasound and an exam.

Dr. Cohen was compassionate, gentle and patient, and his great bedside manner really made a difference in helping my scared and weakened pup feel more at ease. The staff/techs was super friendly and kind, creating a warm, supportive environment that eased my anxiety as well.

With Dr. Cohen's knowledge and thorough approach, my dog's pain and symptoms were effectively managed, including the proper medication and food for her tummy issues. That same night, she started eating on her own for the first time in 9 days! I’m so happy to see her feeling better and acting like her sweet, silly, goofy self again.

Also, the bill for his services was almost 50% less than what we paid at the previous clinic. Thank you, FMAC, for not price gouging like everyone else and for genuinely caring about my dog instead of treating us like just another transaction. I will definitely be returning for future visits with both of my pups! 🐾💖

I brought in several kittens I rescued  for the 1st time from outdoors to this clinic few years ago and the vet said they were clean and didn't have fleas. My home was infested with fleas and it took months to clean. Don't think the vet even checked. When I came back few weeks later and told the vet he said they were still free of fleas and that was not true. I asked if I can get prescription flea medication and he said they don't have it in the office. I don't know how he is with dogs, but after my experience with cat rescue for the past few years I can tell you I don't think this vet knows about cats.

the BEST vet clinic !! everyone is so kind-hearted & i had a great experience with my puppy. from the front desk receptionist, to the vet doctor, the vet assistant, & the pet groomer :) they were all so lovely & i will definitely keep bringing my benji boo <3

So upset with this office been going there for bit with my dog Simba. They gave my dog a new medicine that they raved was a game changer and they have literally paralyzed my dog it’s been a month and my dog can’t walk. I have brought him back and all they told me was that maybe he had a bad reaction to the medicine and has to come out of his system. They haven’t reached out to see how my dog is doing and the lack of non caring is disgusting. I have had to buy harness and even a wheelchair just so he can try to walk. Do your research on any medication that they offer you.

We absolutely love coming here.  I have a dog and two cats and the entire staff works hard to make them as comfortable as they can be. Dr Cohen is knowledgeable and compassionate. The entire staff, whether at the front desk, or the vet techs, are down to earth, hard working, and pleasant to interact with. I genuinely feel like my pets are well cared for and neither myself nor my pet children are stressed out by the experience.

Amazing staff who love and are passionate about animals, great work by the vet and groomers, and my pet is so happy after a visit here which I thought was impossible but Prince is so much happier after his visit. Best place for my pets keep up the amazing job and thank you.
Overall I tho the staff was friendly, it was a quick wait and the dr was over all informative
Dr Cohen is amazing so caring he spot on with diagnosis i love that he still has compassion for your animal and your pockets!!
Nice, caring friendly staff and Dr. Cohen is happy to be one of our Vets.
Amazing animal  Clinic, I’ve visited a few times now with both my cats and they have always answered all my questions and been very welcoming. I would absolutely recommend 10/10

Omg nop, nop and no I call regarding my cat, while explaining that the cat is a rescue and needs to be checked out the lady hang up in my ears I called back a second time and she sounded so rude and unprofessional, before i could get a word out she said book your appointment online and it's $40 down then hang up a second time. No we won't be taking our cat here.

I’ve been bringing my dog to this clinic for years, and the vet Dr. Cohen has always been wonderful—kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. Unfortunately, my experiences with the receptionist multiple times, who I believe is named Amanda (she has colorful hair) has made me unable to return. She is incredibly rude and dismissive, and her attitude completely overshadowed the positive experience with the vet. I’ve never been treated so poorly at a veterinary office, and it was enough to make me look for a new clinic. It’s a shame because Dr.Cohen is great, but I simply can’t continue to bring my dog here with that level of disrespect from staff especially when it comes to something as important as my pet.

A wonderful veterinary practice; Dr. Cohen and his team are knowledgeable, empathetic, gentle and has a great bedside manner to calm frisky kitty.  Close to home, lots of parking places, and very reasonable pricing for quality vet care.  Best of all you can tell everyone truly loves and cares for animals.

Dr. Cohen and his staff have always, for the past ten years, provided our several cat babies with the very best of care. Dr. Cohen is a consummate professional who is always responsive and caring. I recommend him highly and appreciate his efforts on our pets behalf.

I stay close to this place but the attitude of the receptionist is why I immediately changed , it’s been almost 3 years now

. If I am being treated that way, imagine people who don’t have patience with fur babies, they can’t speak ,

It was one of the best decisions to change, as we met one of the best Vets at another place. 30 Minutes drive but it doesn’t affect me AT ALLAs my fur baby is in better hands and I live the front office receptionist, so so welcoming.

I trusted Dr.Cohen and Fresh Meadows Animal Clinic for all of my husky Coby's health needs from the time of our first visit. Unfortunately Coby crossed the Rainbow Bridge last year but Dr. Cohen and his staff were always wonderful with him. He lived a pretty long life for a husky (14 years) and when the time comes to welcome another pet into my life I would definitely use Dr. Cohen again. Thank you to the staff and Dr. Cohen for all the years that they took care of Coby.

Terrible attitude by the receptionist. Judging from many other past reviews, this seems to be a common trend with a few exceptions. I simply asked a very general question over the phone and off the bat, the receptionist came back with a very condescending tone (could almost hear the eye roll over the phone lol). I know I didn't ask anything outrageous since I called 3 other vet clinics before, asking the same question and they were all very kind and courteous replying to the same exact question. (I called at noon on 9/17)

I know some vet receptionists are dealing with calls nonstop but.. at the end of the day you're a client service, no? If they can't respond with some modicum of politeness for a simple, general question, can you imagine how they'd treat you and your pet when there's an actual emergency? I'm surprised they don't train their staff better given most clinics out there are having trouble competing against the onslaught of VC & PE backed vet clinic chains that offer fancier services w nicer facilities..

UPDATE to the doctor's reply:  Sigh... the negative review is NOT to do with the context (the fact that you couldnt give me an estimate over the phone, some other clinics said the same thing). The review was due to the WAY your receptionist conveyed the exact message you typed out in your reply.

Let me make it super clear.... a person can say the same word, for instance, "Thank you!" in either the nicest way, or the haughtiest way ever. What you say, the words, the context, in most cases, doesn't matter as much as HOW you say it. The way the communication is dealt with, can alleviate and mitigate even the worst news to customers. (and for a place that deals with difficult situations, presumably very frequently due to sick or dying pets, it is telling, that your receptionist, 'the voice' and frontline 'face' of your operation can't wrap this concept around her head, and has clearly explained away my negative review to you as "it's the fault of the customer, there wasn't anything I could do, she just wasn't happy that i told her we don't give estimates" ).

Your receptionist explained what you typed out, pretty much the same words, sure. The problem was in the WAY she communicated the exact same context, with clear annoyance, condescension and attitude oozing through her tone and curtness. I felt like I was getting a lecture from an annoyed, angry teacher telling off a pupil, as she explained why you guys don't give estimates.

The fact that you don't understand this simple fact, and did not even imply that you will try to re-train your receptionist or staff speaks volumes about your approach to customer service and the trickle down effect that that has to overall operations.

PS. I merely mentioned the other VC funded vet clinics because I volunteer at vet clinics, actually, and may vets mention worrying about competition, and its hard to compete when they have more ammo in the bank. Hence, I'm curious why you don't want to try to fix the easiest of things to tackle like improving your staff's attitude and demeanor? (Costs zero vs trying to change pricing or what you offer).

I also dog sit for many dogs and many of my pet owners are switching to these "fancy" clinics because of ease and niceties they offer. And guess what? Even if the vets experiences or abilities may not compare, as im sure they dont (and I only know that bc I've volunteered at long-standing vet clinics in Manhattan)  they for sure have their customer service staff trained to a tee, which is why they keep attracting the newer pet owners out there, bc at the end of the day,  when you first look for a vet clinic as a new pet owner, you really can't tell the difference btwn all the vets' expertises out there. All you're going for initially is the routine vaccines and the inevitable giardia issues a new pup gets, and the care you get for that is dime a dozen. At which point, what ends up mattering, is how they're treated by receptionists upfront, and thus, the small interactions such as, attitude over the phone matters. Hope THAT's clearer.
The staff at Fresh Meadows Animal clinic made every effort Boris was well taken care of during his procedure. He is very well loved there.

Amazing staff. My dog Gizmo loves them all. They are so caring and compassionate for their clients. My dog is happy to see the Doctor because of his gentle caring treatment. Definitely one of the best Vets.

I fell the  customer service is better than before
I can trust them more.
I love this clinic , the whole entire team is excellent,  kind , compassionate. They really love and take great care of the animals as if they were there own.

I called in for an estimate on spaying, front desk rep let me know I'd have to come in first for a visit which I was ok with. Started booking, she let me know there was a 40$ deposit and me, not having my credit card on me, I mention i'd have to call right back. She doesn't even respond, hangs up the phone without even letting me finish the sentence......

Couldn't recommend a vet more. we saw dr cohen and amanda who listened to every concern we had and then made a diet plan for my cat who needs to lose two pounds. I am deeply appreciative of the care and consideration they took and how gentle they were on our cat.  They also are really fairly priced compared to all other vets we've been to in the area. So glad to have found our primary vet finally after kissing a lot of toads.

Thank you to Dr. Cohen and the staff for their excellent care of my cat, Cali, during his recent dental cleaning. I was quite stressed about the procedure, particularly because it involved anesthesia. However, the kindness and attentiveness …

The vet and staffs are reliable. Especially, Dr. Cohen is strait forward to the point. I and my dog don't go there to be socialized. I want someone knowledgeable and experienced. This clinic really suits all my needs. Quick follow ups, …

The staff there are very nice with me and Roxy my Cat. And also the the vet is good. He let me know that Roxy good health. I’m little behind with health check up. But I look forward to take her there very soon. Thank you.
